_about: G3 rubric for a LinkedIn post (D-7, D-8). Seeded into G0's rubric store through G0's own loader; scored by G0's evaluation capability (DeterministicJudge + decide()). The item is an object the loop assembles from G0 results and the Critic's hook score: {post, claims_registry, claims_in_source, brand, hook_score}. Criteria are the PRD rubric: claims verified, on-brand, has a hook (4 or more out of 5).

rubrics.title: LinkedIn post: claims verified, on-brand, has a hook

criteria.description: No claim in the post is `unsupported` by the shared claims registry.
Every number, URL and quote in the post appears in the source note (G0 rubric claim_rule_v1).
No violation of brand policy v1 or g3-skill-1 on channel linkedin.
The first line gives a reason to keep reading: the Critic scores the hook 4 or more out of 5.
No hype words from the shared hype list.
